videos.description: The key to global warming may lie underground: soil contains far more carbon than the atmosphere, but overdevelopment of farmland releases it as CO2. We explore efforts to capture carbon in the soil.

videos.title: The Seasons of Yamato
videos.description: Visiting the Kasugayama Primeval Forest, where colourful autumn maple leaves float on the water's surface. According to the 24 Solar Terms of Reiwa 6, Shousetsu is from November 22 to December 7.

videos.description: Earthquakes often cause water pipes to break, leading to water outages. That's why efforts are underway to make water pipes more earthquake-resistant and anticipate areas of potential damage.

videos.description: Learn how to ask about locations. If you want to know where something is, simply put wa doko desu ka after its name.

videos.title: Culture Crossroads
videos.description: The fact that Japan is very dry in winter greatly increases the risk of fire. We learn tips for preventing fires from occurring and how to respond effectively when a fire breaks out.
